wikitext.*:
Status effects are buffs and debuffs, affecting the player's gameplay during the cooking sections. Some effects lack a defined duration and last the entire night, others have a fixed length.

Effects are shown on the right side of the UI, with small paper notes with sketches for each effect.

Some effects can be acquired through multiple means across categories: the full effect, with all acquisition methods, will be listed everywhere applicable.

== Sparrow Tune ==
Sparrow Tune buffs are gained at a random chance when completing a perfect Sparrow Tune. The likelyhood can be seen in the player's profile, under Sparrow Tune Buff Probability - this caps at 80%. The same buff cannot be acquired multiple times.
